habitat: Grassy woodland and grassland, especially near rocky koppies. In eastern Zimbabwe it uses montane grassland.
summary: An uncommon to locally common resident. Legs dull yellow. Above dark grey-brown, blotched black and streaked white. White throat with a black surround, a white stripe through the eye and ear coverts, white underparts, the breast blotched deep red to red-brown and extending to the upper flanks, the belly barred black, and bold black blotches on the lower flanks. The call is a shrill musical crowing like I’ll drink yer beer, three or four times. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.

research.note: Newman calls it an uncommon to locally common resident, so status is resident and all twelve months are listed. Dull yellow legs are stored as yellow. Grey-winged Francolin is the comparison Newman names and is not in this list. Population figures and the Kemp code RB were left unchanged.
